title: Published annual pasture surface-runoff loading cases

source.title: Endale et al. (2021), Runoff nutrient losses from tall fescue pastures
source.locator: Supplemental Table S4, PDF page 14, individual grazed treatment Mean rows for Total N and Total P

context.location: Dawson Field, Watkinsville, Georgia, Southern Piedmont
context.design: Randomized blocks; two approximately 1 ha paddocks per treatment
context.soil: Cecil (~80%), Pacolet (12%), Appling (8%); sandy loam to sandy clay loam surface; clayey Bt
context.application_rate: Not specified by this loading recipe; no fertilizer application instruction is inferred

measurement.statistic: Published mean of annual load estimates
measurement.gap_filling: Authors imputed missing events from annual 10th–85th percentile means; 10th–80th when the 85th percentile was at least three times the 80th.

comparisons.name: novel / broiler litter to inorganic fertilizer
comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive published treatment contrast; keep both N and P outcomes, without a significance or local-causality claim.

comparisons.name: wild / broiler litter to inorganic fertilizer
comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive published treatment contrast; keep both N and P outcomes, without a significance or local-causality claim.

comparisons.name: free / broiler litter to inorganic fertilizer
comparisons.interpretation: Descriptive published treatment contrast; keep both N and P outcomes, without a significance or local-causality claim.

native_mapping.subsurface_assumption: proportion_subsurface_n=0 is a declared scenario boundary, not a measurement of no subsurface nitrogen.

excluded.hayed: Main abstract and methods/table disagree on endophyte identity; omitted.
excluded.s5_pooled_totals: Do not substitute treatment-pooled multiyear totals for individual annual coefficients.
excluded.local_calibration: No claim that the six values characterize the selected project.
